guide:0:0:0.text: Build around [The One Who Grips](persona:0204) Faust's Whistles combat passive and Identities with Lust skills. This is a less powerful foundation than other team archetypes and is included as a supplementary option.

guide:1:0:0.text: At 4 Lust Resonance, Whistles restores 15 SP to the 2 lowest-SP allies at Combat Start. This accelerates the opening in story and other battles starting at 0 SP.

guide:1:0:1.text: Also restores SP lost after using E.G.O.

guide:1:0:2.text: [The One Who Grips](persona:0204) pairs strongly with [The Ring Pointillist Student](persona:0109) Yi Sang. Nails, Gaze, and Bleed from her S2 are negative effects, helping guarantee his S2 reuse.

guide:2:0:0.text: Whistles also grants Fanatic when healing N Corp. Fanatics. The One Who Grips's Nails create more opportunities for Fanatic to activate, making her compatible with them.

guide:2:0:1.text: [N Corp. Mittelhammer](persona:0304) Don Quixote has Lust S1 and defense, making Whistles easy to trigger. She gains bonuses from Fanatic but cannot gain it alone, so Whistles fits her well.

guide:2:0:2.text: [N Corp. Mittelhammer](persona:0904) Rodion excels at gaining Fanatic. At Uptie Ⅳ in an N Corp. team, [The One Who Shall Grip](persona:1005) Sinclair grants allies a +10% damage buff.

guide:2:0:3.text: [N Corp. Großhammer](persona:0504) Meursault has no Lust and cannot contribute to Whistles, so choose him or Mittelhammer Don Quixote when focusing on Lust.

guide:2:0:4.text: Benched [N Corp. Kleinhammer](persona:0704) Heathcliff increases the fastest ally's Nails application by 1. Has no effect unless The One Who Grips is fastest.

guide:2:0:5.text: Together, N Corp.'s [Fell Bullet](persona:0113) Yi Sang and [Contempt, Awe](persona:0412) Ryōshū let Fell Bullet deal damage without killing allies.

guide:3:0:0.text: Ideally, more than half the team has Lust skills. Having 2 Identities with both Lust attacks and Lust defense makes Resonance easier to form.

guide:3:0:1.text: Lust defense can connect Lust Resonance even without a Lust attack available. Prioritize Uptie Ⅳ for Identities whose defense becomes Lust at that stage.

guide:3:0:2.text: [The One Who Grips](persona:0204) can activate Whistles in any Lust-heavy team. House of Spiders teams have many Lust S1 users, including [Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415) Ryōshū and [The Index Proxy](persona:0314) Don Quixote. The Bloodfiend Bleed variant already includes her.

guide:4:0:0.text: During the opening, evading to activate Whistles often contributes more than forcing The One Who Grips to attack.

guide:4:0:1.text: Gaze from her S2 increases damage taken from Pierce and Blunt skills by 20%. Pair her with those attack types.

guide:4:0:2.text: Healing mainly comes from Faust's [Fluid Sac](ego:0202). The One Who Grips supplies Lust and Envy, so use other Sinners to cover Gloom.

guide:5:0:0.text: SP builds quickly, but the team is not especially suited to long battles.
